title: Light chicken tikka masala with basmati rice
steps: Dice the chicken and marinate it with 80 g yoghurt, half the spices and salt for at least 20 minutes.
Cook the rice according to the packet.
Fry the chicken in 1 tsp oil in a hot pan for 5 minutes and set aside.
Chop the onion, garlic and ginger, soften in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, toast the remaining spices for 1 minute, add the passata and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the chicken, cream and remaining yoghurt, heat through for 5 minutes and serve with coriander and rice.
